entities.name: Nariman bey Narimanbeyov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nariman bey Hashim oglu Narimanbeyov, also known as Nariman bey Narimanbeyli, was an Azerbaijani lawyer and statesman who served as State Controller in the fourth cabinet of Azerbaijan Democratic Republic, and was member of Parliament of Azerbaijan.
